newAssets.subject: Adult neutral anatomical anterior body silhouette showing only supported superficial muscle display-group shapes, bilateral clean paths and truthful anatomy.
newAssets.brief: Produce an original clean anterior front-view anatomical muscle-region vector for a premium consumer workout-history dashboard. Full adult neutral human silhouette from head/neck to feet, natural proportions, calm pose with arms slightly separated and palms appropriately oriented. Clear region boundaries for pectorals, anterior/lateral deltoid, biceps/forearm, abdominals/obliques, quadriceps and calves where actually visible; do not pretend posterior muscles are visible from front. No organs, transparent X-ray or physiology gauges. Each clickable group represented by stable nonoverlapping SVG path IDs for sides, semantically grouped to the 15-group taxonomy; unrepresented regions neutral. Provide complete source SVG with unobstructed outlines plus separately reviewed JSON path→muscle mappings, viewBox and orientation. Consistent stroke and spatial proportions with posterior pair. CSS tokenized blue/light/dark; no embedded numbers, labels, heatmap color values, text, logos, diagnosis symbols or gradients that obscure click regions.

pathIdConvention.requiredMapping: All enabled SVG path ids must have an explicit one-to-one mapping to a supported canonical group; neutral geometry noninteractive; bilateral paths may share group.

Actual source files and SHA plus licensed origin confirmed
No auto promotion to integrated or anatomy-approved

Neutral adult rear silhouette, arms gently offset from torso, legs naturally separated, with clearly mapped rear deltoids, traps/upper back, lats, erector spinae region, triceps/forearms, glutes, hamstrings and posterior calves only where surface anatomy supports them.
